parameters.query:
-- Drafts that editors have not touched within SLA.
SELECT id, platform, created_at, scheduled_at, left(body, 120) AS preview
FROM content.drafts
WHERE org_id = $1
  AND status = 'pending_review'
  AND queued_at IS NOT NULL                 -- only alert on drafts actually visible to editors
  AND created_at < now() - interval '2 hours'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 50;

-- Items locked in a transitional status for longer than 30 minutes.
-- WF06 sets status='fanning_out' + locked_at=now() when it claims an item,
-- and clears locked_at only when all plannedCount drafts have queued_at set.
-- If LLM / QA / Google Sheets fails for any branch the item stays here,
-- otherwise invisible to operators.
-- WF08 sets status='batch_rewriting' with the same locked_at convention.
SELECT id, status, source, title, locked_at,
       extract(epoch FROM (now() - locked_at))::int AS stuck_seconds
FROM content.items
WHERE org_id = $1
  AND status IN ('fanning_out','batch_rewriting')
  AND locked_at IS NOT NULL
  AND locked_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY locked_at ASC
LIMIT 50;

nodes.name: Stuck fan-out items
nodes.notes: Closes the dead-letter path that used to exist when an item was moved to 'fanning_out' by WF06 and then any downstream step threw. The item would never be picked up again (WF06 only claims 'enriched'). Now it surfaces here after 30 minutes so on-call can manually requeue: UPDATE content.items SET status='enriched', locked_at=NULL, updated_at=now() WHERE id='<id>'; -- or investigate root cause first.
